scalar problems allow terms in \cref{eq:LTE_coeffs} to commute, for example $I \otimes g'(y(t))$ and $(I - A \otimes Z)^{-1}$, and leads to an incomplete set of order conditions.
&= \sum_{i=0}^{s-1} \sum_{j=0}^{s-1} (b^T A^i A^j \so{2}) Q_i(Z) g'(y(\timevar)) Q_j(Z) y''(\timevar) .

issues.failure_explanation: F(τ;Z,t) = (I−R(Z))^{-1}ψ(τ;Z,t) is not the matrix functional-calculus value of the scalar rational function F(τ;z,t): ψ(τ;Z,t) contains Z nested inside non-commuting factors, e.g. Q_i(Z) g'(y) Q_j(Z). Hence the scalar Nevanlinna/von Neumann theorem cannot transfer the bound sup_z |F(τ;z,t)| to ||F(τ;Z,t)||, and the removable-pole argument (ψ(τ;0,t)=0 by classical order) controls only the fully non-stiff limit. Concretely, for a mixed Z = diag(0,−Λ) and a coupling nonlinearity, the nonstiff component of ψ(4b;Z,t) tends to g^{(1;1)}_{12}(t)·b^T C (I+ΛA)^{-1}γ_2·y_2''(t), which is nonzero unless b^T C A^i γ_2 = 0 for all i (the j=0 part of semilinear condition 4b, an order-p condition not implied by p_SL = p−1 and classical order p), while (1−R(0))^{-1} is infinite. Then ξ_n is unbounded, (Eq:EstimateXi) fails, and the nonstiff error component accumulates to O(h^{p_SL}), contradicting q = p_SL+1 uniformly in J. The theorem's superconvergence case is therefore unsupported and false in general as stated.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add to the superconvergence hypothesis the j = 0 semilinear conditions b^T C^ℓ(β_1×...×β_k) = 0 for all trees of order p (for all β_i ∈ V_{τ_i}), and Eq:Rcondition; then write ψ(τ;Z,t) = Σ_{j≥1} coef_j Q_j(Z) w_j(Z,t) with bounded w_j, bound (I−R(Z))^{-1}Q_j(Z) by the scalar theorem, and verify the extra conditions for each proposed method.
issues.overall_effect: The q = p_SL+1 guarantee of Theorem thm:convergence is unreliable. The paper's claims of full order p convergence for methods with p_SL = p−1 (ESDIRK-(8,4,3), ESDIRK-(10,5,4), EDIRK-(19,5,4)) and 'up to fifth order B-convergence' rest on it; ESDIRK-(8,4,3) is rescued by C(2), but the required order-5 conditions (e.g. b^T C A^i γ_3 = 0 for all i, from tree 5d) are not verified for ESDIRK-(10,5,4), and Eq:Rcondition is never checked for any new method. The q = p_SL case is unaffected.
issues.title: Superconvergence proof misapplies scalar von Neumann bound to a non-commutative Z-expression; q = p_SL+1 fails without extra order-p conditions
issues.why_classification: The stated theorem is false without a new hypothesis; the repair changes the guarantee's scope, requires a replacement argument, and leaves the fifth-order convergence claim for the flagship ESDIRK-(10,5,4) unestablished by the source.
